verdict.rationale: No first-party docs describe a telemetry opt-out. Community users report config switches in ~/.grok/config.toml ([harness] disable_codebase_upload=true; [telemetry] trace_upload=false and [features] telemetry=false, though the last two came from asking the CLI itself and are unverified). A wire-level analysis reports the built-in 'Improve the model' toggle has no effect on uploads, and users turned to third-party privacy forks and scripts to strip telemetry. Opt-out is therefore achievable only through undocumented, community-sourced workarounds. Missing for 10: official documentation of telemetry/usage-tracking controls, verified evidence that the config flags actually stop data collection, and a working first-party opt-out toggle.
